```{webr}
# install.packages("sonify")
library(sonify)

# Convert note names to frequencies (equal temperament, A4 = 440)
note_to_freq <- function(note) {
  note_names <- c("C", "C#", "D", "D#", "E", "F",
                  "F#", "G", "G#", "A", "A#", "B")
  
  m <- regexec("^([A-G]#?)(-?[0-9]+)$", note)
  parts <- regmatches(note, m)[[1]]
  
  if (length(parts) == 0) stop("Bad note format: ", note)
  
  pitch <- parts[2]
  octave <- as.integer(parts[3])
  
  semitone_index <- match(pitch, note_names) - 1
  midi <- 12 * (octave + 1) + semitone_index
  
  440 * 2^((midi - 69) / 12)
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# A short ORIGINAL "rickroll-adjacent" phrase:
# upbeat 80s-style contour, but not the exact melody
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
notes <- c(
  "B4","C#5","D5","D5","E5","C#5","B4","A4",
  "B4","B4","C#5","D5","B4","A4","A5","A5","E5",
  "B4","B4","C#5","D5","B4","D5","E5","C#5","B4","C#5","B4","A4",
  "B4","B4","C#5","D5","B4","A4","E5","E5","E5","F#5","E5",
  
  "D5","E5","F#5","D5","E5","E5","E5","F#5","E5","A4",
  "B4","C#5","D5","B4","E5","F#5","E5",
  
  "A4","B4","D5","B4","F#5","F#5","E5",
  "A4","B4","D5","B4","E5","E5","D5","C#5","B4",
  "A4","B4","D5","B4","D5","E5","C#5","A4","A4","E5","D5",
  
  "A4","B4","D5","B4","F#5","F#5","E5",
  "A4","B4","D5","B4","A5","C#5","D5","C#5","B4",
  "A4","B4","D5","B4","D5","E5","C#5","A4","A4","E5","D5"
)

dur <- 0.3*c(
  # We're no strangers to love
  1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 2,
  
  # You know the rules and so do I
  1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 2,
  
  # A full commitment's what I'm thinking of
  1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 2,
  
  # You wouldn't get this from any other guy
  1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 2,
  
  # I just wanna tell you how I'm feeling
  0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 1.5,
  
  # Gotta make you understand
  0.5, 0.5, 1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 2,
  
  # Never gonna give you up
  0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 1, 2,
  
  # Never gonna let you down
  0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 2,
  
  # Never gonna run around and desert you
  0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 2,
  
  # Never gonna make you cry
  0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 1, 2,
  
  # Never gonna say goodbye
  0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 2,
  
  # Never gonna tell a lie and hurt you
  0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 0.75, 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 0.75, 2
)
length(notes)
length(dur)

freqs <- sapply(notes, note_to_freq)

# sonify() wants x positions and y values.
# With interpolation = "constant", each y is held until the next x.
x <- c(0, cumsum(dur))

# Need one extra y so the last note has something to hold to the end
y <- c(freqs, tail(freqs, 1))

# Play it
w <- sonify(
  x = x,
  y = y,
  duration = sum(dur),
  interpolation = "constant",
  waveform = "sawtooth",   # "sine" is softer; "square" is more retro
  flim = range(y),       # map directly over this pitch range
  amp_level = 0.2,
  stereo = FALSE,
  play = TRUE
)
```

```{webr}
# Top-line chorus transcription for the marked "Chorus" section,
# encoded as note events and rendered with the sonify package.
# Durations are in beats; set bpm to match your arrangement.

library(sonify)

bpm <- 113
beat_sec <- 60 / bpm

# Approximate melody from the chorus shown in the image.
# Use NA for rests.
chorus <- data.frame(
  note = c(
    # "Got-ta make you"
    NA, NA, "D4", "E4", "F4", "D4",
    # "un-der-stand"
    "G4", "A4", "G4",
    # "Nev-er gon-na give you up"
    "C4", "D4", "D4", "F4", "F4", "E4",
    # "Nev-er gon-na let you down"
    "C4", "D4", "F4", "F4", "E4", "D4",
    # "Nev-er gon-na run a-round and de-sert you"
    "C4", "D4", "E4", "F4", "E4", "D4", "C4", "D4",
    # "Nev-er gon-na make you cry"
    "C4", "D4", "D4", "F4", "F4", "E4",
    # "Nev-er gon-na say good-bye"
    "C5", "E4", "F4", "F4", "E4", "D4",
    # "Nev-er gon-na tell a lie and hurt you"
    "C4", "D4", "E4", "F4", "E4", "D4", "C4"
  ),
  beats = c(
    1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5,
    0.5, 0.5, 2,
    0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 1, 2,
    0.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 1, 1.5,
    0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 1,
    0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 1, 2,
    1, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.5,
    0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 2
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

note_to_midi <- function(note) {
  if (is.na(note)) return(NA_real_)
  
  pc_map <- c(
    C = 0, `C#` = 1, Db = 1,
    D = 2, `D#` = 3, Eb = 3,
    E = 4,
    F = 5, `F#` = 6, Gb = 6,
    G = 7, `G#` = 8, Ab = 8,
    A = 9, `A#` = 10, Bb = 10,
    B = 11
  )
  
  m <- regexec("^([A-G](?:#|b)?)(-?\\d+)$", note)
  parts <- regmatches(note, m)[[1]]
  pitch_class <- parts[2]
  octave <- as.integer(parts[3])
  
  12 * (octave + 1) + pc_map[[pitch_class]]
}

midi_to_freq <- function(midi) {
  if (is.na(midi)) return(NA_real_)
  440 * 2^((midi - 69) / 12)
}

# Convert note events into a stepwise frequency series for sonify()
events_to_series <- function(notes, beats, beat_sec) {
  starts <- c(0, cumsum(head(beats, -1))) * beat_sec
  ends   <- cumsum(beats) * beat_sec
  
  freqs <- vapply(notes, function(n) midi_to_freq(note_to_midi(n)), numeric(1))
  
  x <- numeric(0)
  y <- numeric(0)
  
  for (i in seq_along(freqs)) {
    s <- starts[i]
    e <- ends[i]
    
    if (is.na(freqs[i])) {
      # skip rests so they remain silent
      next
    }
    
    # duplicate each note at start/end for constant interpolation
    x <- c(x, s, e - 1e-6)
    y <- c(y, freqs[i], freqs[i])
  }
  
  list(x = x, y = y, duration = max(ends))
}

series <- events_to_series(chorus$note, chorus$beats, beat_sec)

# Play it
sonify(
  y = series$y,
  x = series$x,
  duration = series$duration,
  play = TRUE,
  interpolation = "constant"
)

```
